title: Civil/ Structural Engineer
abstract: We are looking for a Civil / Structural Engineer to join our major projects team located in Rockdale, NSW.
screening_questions: Which of the following CAD software do you have experience with?
How would you rate your English language skills?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil and Structural Engineer?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have in the construction industry?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Which of the following Microsoft Office products are you experienced with?
content_text:
Our business is focused on giving effective and practical advice tailored to suit the needs of the client. Providing Builders and Insurers with insurance reports and scopes of work for residential, commercial and industrial property damage. We also provide Structural, Civil and Stormwater design for a wide range of developments including residential, commercial and industrial properties. 
The opportunity
A fantastic opportunity is available for an engineer to join our team.
You will mainly focus on existing buildings with fire damage, tree and vehicle impacts with a 50/50 split between on-site and office work.
Why join us?
Competitive remuneration - you'll be recognised for your experience with an attractive package. Additional incentives - enjoy a transparent performance-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work and dedication Job security - this is a long-term career opportunity in a business that has ambitious growth plans for both the business and our people. You will be mentored by experienced engineers and have exposure to a broad range of disciplines, including Structural, Civil, Geotechnical, Stormwater and Architectural designers.
We offer a 30-week Engineering Seminar Program, a structured professional development course designed to strengthen technical expertise and practical engineering skills. Open to all engineers within our organisation, it offers a valuable opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, develop theoretical and practical engineering expertise, and build a strong foundation for long-term career growth.
Requirements
Completed your Civil/Structural Engineering degree. Passion for Engineering.   Strong technical report writing skills.  Excellent attention to detail. Structural behaviour instinct.  Keen to learn and be mentored and be a part of the team. High level of English writing and structural analytical skills will be highly regarded.  Ability to utilise Autocad. 
Responsibilities
Achieving client satisfaction prepare causation reports on defects and damage. Prepare scope of works Work effectively to keep billings up to date Performing site inspections and liaising with all stake holders. Perform structural design of timber, steel and concrete structures and associated drafting. Maintain a high level of attention to detail in all technical aspects related to buildings.
Continued professional development and involvement in appropriate industry associations.
Visa sponsorships may be considered.
